title: Evaluating the Durability of Closure for Diabetic Foot Ulcers Following a Randomized, Controlled, Modified Platform Trial.
official: A Prospective Multicenter Study Evaluating the Durability of Closure for Diabetic Foot Ulcers Following a Randomized, Controlled, Modified Platform Trial
summary: Prospective long-term follow-up on durability of closure evaluated by photographic and thermal scanning.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* The potential subject must have participated in the CAMPX trial and achieved complete closure by the 12-week endpoint.

Exclusion Criteria:

* The potential subject did not participate in the CAMPX trial.
* The potential subject participated in the CAMPX trial and did not achieve complete closure.
